# MBrain

> MBrain is an independent digital studio working across creative websites, digital products and platforms, automations and integrations, and digital project leadership.

## Method

MBrain works through three stages: Thought, Shape and Build.

- Thought: challenge the request and identify the actual business need.
- Shape: turn that need into a clear blueprint, structure and approach.
- Build: develop, coordinate or lead the work through delivery.

## Services

- [Creative Web Experiences](https://mbrain.gr/#services): Creative websites and digital experiences with a distinct identity and purpose.
- [Automations & Integrations](https://mbrain.gr/#services): Workflows, APIs, system integrations and useful automation.
- [Digital Products & Platforms](https://mbrain.gr/#services): Product and platform architecture, UX direction and buildable blueprints.
- [Digital Project Leadership](https://mbrain.gr/#services): Temporary ownership and leadership for digital projects that need structure and delivery.

## About

MBrain is led by Michalis Vranis and combines hands-on building, digital product thinking, technology, automation and project delivery.
